evidence_detail: Page read is genuine: I re-extracted PDF page index 19 (1-based p20) myself and read 'Ethyl acetate...... 6.02 25 1.5 at 25 8,63,276'. So the row is not fabricated and is reproducible from the held PDF (sha256 cb3fa923...). BUT it is not new evidence: dielectric_v04.csv row 104 already carries inchikey XEKOWRVHYACXOJ-UHFFFAOYSA-N, dielectric=6.02, T_K=298.15, source_doi=10.6028/nbs.circ.514, source_record_id=nbs514:p20:022, source_page=20, model_ready=True; the identical value is in dielectric_v02/v03/v031/v032 and in the frozen v03_original_243.csv. B03 therefore added ZERO new evidence and re-verified a row already in the frozen dataset. B03's own source_verification.csv admits 'epsilon_agrees=true' against the frozen v04 value, i.e. the check was confirmatory by construction. Method defects: NBS514 gives no frequency for this row (frequency_note is NaN; only 44 of 200 part-1 rows carry any frequency statement), no purity, no uncertainty (v04 uncertainty=NaN), and the compilation entry is a secondary relay of refs 8,63,276 - not a primary measurement. CONTRADICTING VALUES EXIST: data/raw/open_data_eps/eps_observations.csv holds EA at 6.081 @293.15 K (PMC11397147), 6.500 (PMC12558406) and 6.000 (PMC13567569) against the admitted 6.02 @298.15 K - a ~1.3% spread at 5 K apart that is larger than the reported 3-figure precision, so the value is not reproducible to its stated precision. Note also the internal contradiction: A18_gap_register.csv records EA as n_observations=0, n_source_documents=0, evidence_status=ZERO_OBSERVATION while v04 simultaneously holds a model_ready EA row.

STRONGEST CONTRADICTION IN THE WHOLE PACKAGE: data/raw/open_data_eps/eps_observations.csv holds MA at 7.072 @288.15 K (PMC11397147) and 7.200 (PMC12558406) - i.e. 7.072 vs the admitted 6.68 is +5.9% at a temperature only 10 K lower, and epsilon rises as T falls, so the two are mutually inconsistent in direction AND magnitude for a single-substance static permittivity. Either 6.68 is low, or the 7.07/7.20 legs are not static/low-frequency values. B03 never reconciled this and never mentioned it. Also: ref 63 (Williams & Krchma, JACS 49, 1676, 1927) is cited by BOTH the MA entry and the EA entry, so the two 'new measurements' are not independent of each other either.

Systemic defects. (1) INFLATED RESOLVED COUNT: the headline '5/18 resolved' is not reproducible from B03's own register - A18_gap_register.csv gives n_condition_valid_pairs>=1 for only DMC, DEC, SL (3/18); EA and MA are recorded there as n_condition_valid_pairs=0, n_source_documents=0, ZERO_OBSERVATION. provenance_repair/condition_pair_validity_v1.csv independently marks EA and MA condition_pair_valid=False with invalidity_reason=NO_CONTRIBUTING_MEASUREMENTS and n_contributing_sources=0. So the 5 count mixes two incompatible standards: 3 molecules with ledger-backed condition-valid pairs, plus 2 molecules whose only support is a PENDING_FOUR_AGENT_REVIEW page read that B03 itself excluded from the ledger. The defensible number is 3/18; if 'resolved' is reserved for admitted evidence it is 0/18, since nothing has been admitted. (2) NO NEW EVIDENCE AT ALL: both 'new' measurements already sit in the frozen v04 dataset from the identical source_record_id, and B03 explicitly added zero rows to measurement_ledger (2065 unchanged). Net evidence-base growth from B03 is zero molecules, zero admitted measurements. (3) FALSE 'NO OBSERVATION' CHARACTERISATION: unresolved_molecules.csv labels EMC, EC, PC, FEC, VC, DOL, TMP as NO_OBSERVATION_AND_NO_PAGE_READ with n_observations=0, yet all seven already hold curated v04 rows with DOIs - EC 90.5 @313.15 (primary, 10.1021/je050341y), PC 64.9 @298.15 (primary, 10.1021/j100702a008), FEC 78.4 @296.15 (primary, 10.1016/S0022-1139(02)00317-2), VC 126.0 @298 (primary, 10.1039/j29660000005), EMC 2.96, DOL 7.3, TMP 21.6. Calling these 'no observation' because they are absent from the ThermoML observation layer is a category error and materially understates the evidence base. (4) MISLEADING NBS514 FRAMING: EC, PC, FEC, VC post-date or post-detail a 1951 compilation and could never have been in it; 'NO_NBS514_COVERAGE' is a tautology, not a finding, and B03 states it 'needs another source' without acknowledging that other sources are already held. (5) INDEPENDENCE NOT PROPAGATED: independent_source_map.csv has shared_a18_molecules empty for all 8 pairs and n_entangled_sources=0 for EA and MA, so the entanglement finding touches the A18 set only via tca.2012.10.024 and je900503p. The report does state 'independent source count is an upper bound' and directs B07 to deduplicate, so the caveat is present - but the A18 register still reports independent_source_status=DUAL_SOURCE/CLUSTER_GE3 per molecule with no independence discount applied, and DMSO is still counted CLUSTER_GE3 while 4 sources collapse under entanglement. Additionally EA and MA are themselves entangled with each other via shared NBS514 reference 63 (Williams & Krchma 1927), a pair B03 did not detect. (6) INCONSISTENT FREQUENCY GATE: AN is held back for NON_STATIC_FREQUENCY_PRESENT/RF_ONLY, yet EA and MA are pushed forward on a source with NO stated frequency at all - an unstated frequency was treated as more admissible than a stated RF one.
